purpose: Map external research reporting, bias, certainty and model-transparency standards to Human Infra evidence and model-admission gates. This register is an anchor map only: it does not prove intervention effects, model calibration, individual prediction, medical advice, or longevity escape velocity.

standardAnchors.title: TRIPOD+AI reporting guidance for AI and machine-learning prediction model studies
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report AI/ML prediction model development, validation and update studies with transparent intended-use, data, predictor, outcome, validation and performance details.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: L4 validation/calibration report completeness gate for life-path prediction models.

standardAnchors.title: PROBAST / PROBAST+AI risk-of-bias and applicability route for prediction model studies
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Assess risk of bias and applicability for prediction model studies before using model claims as Human Infra evidence.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Bias/applicability review gate for prediction-model source cards and L4 report packets.

standardAnchors.title: STROBE statement for observational studies
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report cohort, case-control and cross-sectional observational evidence transparently.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Source-card reporting-quality screen for observational epidemiology and cohort evidence.

standardAnchors.title: RECORD statement for routinely collected health data studies
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report studies using routinely collected health data with database, linkage, coding and completeness transparency.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: NHANES/NHATS/RWE source-card reporting-quality screen when administrative or registry data are used.

standardAnchors.title: CONSORT reporting guidance for randomized trials
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report randomized trial design, allocation, participant flow, harms, outcomes and interpretation transparently.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Clinical intervention source-card reporting-quality screen before any randomized evidence is used.

standardAnchors.title: SPIRIT guidance for clinical trial protocols
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Check whether trial protocol claims expose objectives, eligibility, interventions, outcomes, sample size, monitoring and ethics before trial evidence is consumed.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Pre-results and protocol-only trial evidence boundary for Human Infra source cards.

standardAnchors.title: CONSORT-AI extension for clinical trials evaluating AI interventions
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report randomized trials of AI interventions with intervention inputs/outputs, human-AI interaction, error handling and integration details.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: AI clinical decision support evidence boundary before AI tools are admitted as intervention or conversion-channel evidence.

standardAnchors.title: SPIRIT-AI extension for clinical trial protocols involving AI interventions
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Check AI trial protocols for intervention details, integration, human factors, input data, output handling and monitoring before results exist.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Protocol-only AI intervention boundary for Human Infra AI and healthcare conversion-channel source cards.

standardAnchors.title: PRISMA 2020 statement for systematic reviews
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Report systematic review search, screening, eligibility, synthesis, bias and certainty workflow transparently.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Evidence-synthesis and literature-review packet gate before claims are summarized across studies.

standardAnchors.title: GRADE working group evidence certainty route
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Translate bodies of evidence into certainty judgments while separating risk of bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision and publication bias.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Certainty-level field for source-card aggregation and evidence-to-decision notes.

standardAnchors.title: RoB 2 tool for risk of bias in randomized trials
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Assess bias in randomized trial effect estimates across randomization, deviations, missing outcome data, outcome measurement and selective reporting.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Bias assessment field for randomized clinical intervention source cards.

standardAnchors.title: ROBINS-I / ROBINS-I v2 route for non-randomized studies of interventions
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Assess risk of bias in non-randomized intervention evidence before translating it into causal or intervention claims.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Non-randomized intervention source-card bias field for longevity, healthcare and policy intervention evidence.

standardAnchors.title: Target trial emulation route for causal questions in observational data
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Frame observational causal questions by specifying the trial that would answer the question, including eligibility, treatment strategies, assignment, follow-up, outcome and estimand.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Causal design preflight before RWE or cohort evidence can support intervention-adjacent claims.

standardAnchors.title: STaRT-RWE structured template for planning and reporting real-world evidence studies
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Structure real-world evidence planning and reporting so design choices, data sources, populations, exposures, outcomes and analysis plans are explicit.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: RWE evidence packet template for observational intervention and service-continuity sources.

standardAnchors.title: ISPOR-SMDM Modeling Good Research Practices route
standardAnchors.primaryUse: Check decision-model structure, transparency, validation, uncertainty and reporting before model outputs are used for interpretation.
standardAnchors.humanInfraPlacement: Life-path model transparency, sensitivity and validation-calibration governance route.

blockedUses: using a guideline mention as proof that a source is true
using a standard route as proof that a Human Infra prediction model is calibrated
using any anchor to output individual death dates or individual medical decisions
using reporting compliance as evidence of longevity escape velocity
